The '''Amma protest''' was a civil demonstration by the population of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Amma]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. Protesting against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] atrocities, the demonstrators peacefully marched on [[Central Sector Square]]. The protestors were met by a line of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] backed by [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] who opened fire after the assembled masses refused to disperse.<ref name="FBS" />
{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Amma protest was first mentioned in the [[1995]] RPG sourcebook ''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]'' and served as historical background for several characters. The book placed the event one year prior to its main story, which was set some weeks after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="FBS" /> thus in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The article "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" from ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7]]'' later placed the Amma protest on 36:6:7 GrS (in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]), incorrectly positioning the protest after ''Flashpoint! Brak Sector''{{'s}} main story.<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
